$comment: Requirement IDs: TRN-01, TRN-02, TRN-06 | Single source of truth for shared contract #1 (DP-B §3.1). Envelope strict, payload open. No domain noun may become a first-class field. | v1.1.0 (2026-09-10, StayQuiet entry): step_id pattern widened from ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ to also accept '_' as the word separator. MINOR, not breaking: every id valid under v1.0.0 is still valid, and the field carries no semantics (see its description). Rationale: this entry's step ids are also the Python tool names its agent loop calls, which must be snake_case identifiers; keeping one vocabulary avoids a name-translation layer between a tool, its progress envelope and its UI label. Codegen unaffected — neither event-envelope.ts nor event_envelope.py reflects the pattern.
title: EventEnvelope
description: Generic live-process event — TRN-01/TRN-02/TRN-06. No domain noun is a first-class field; payload is arbitrary.

step_id.description: Opaque lower-case step identifier, words separated by '-' or '_'. No semantics enforced. Examples: retrieval-pass, widget-overview, synthesis, policy_diff, draft_reply.

status.description: Lifecycle value for the step. started → (0..n streaming) → done|error. No other values permitted.

payload.description: Arbitrary domain payload. Envelope never interprets it. May be {} or contain delta/content degraded markers. No domain noun at envelope top-level.

sequence.description: Monotone per-trace sequence counter. Used for ordering and optional reconnect replay extension. No gap tolerance required in v1.

trace_id.description: Optional correlation id across steps of one run. UUID v4.

degraded.description: True only if payload is (or contains) a DegradedResult per DP-A contracts/degraded-result.schema.json. UI-RES-02 checks degraded===true. Defaults to false.
